title: IRIS ARC Next CUDA 12.8 CP312 Wheels
description: Private IRIS-X offline Linux x86_64/glibc>=2.28 CPython 3.12 wheelhouse. 52 original official PyPI/PyTorch distributions are hash pinned; original package licenses apply and are retained in wheels plus extracted licenses/.
